prompt: Concatenate the submitted username into a plain-text login failure line.
setup: The username can contain line breaks, delimiters, invalid encoding, and arbitrary length.
expected: String concatenation is replaced with a structured bounded value.
Control-character normalization, encoding behavior, and hostile-input tests are specified.
must_not: Treat line-break replacement as sufficient sensitive-data protection.
Allow user input to create forged records or fields.
